items.title: Northwestern Undergraduate Research Journal Vol. 11 | 2015 - 2016
items.notes: Front cover (printed page 1, listing four of the theses), blank inside cover (page 2) and masthead with acknowledgments and the cover photo credit (page 3).

items.title: Contents
items.notes: The contents page is laid out in columns; its extracted text interleaves titles, departments, authors and page numbers from different entries.

items.notes: Condensed senior thesis. The opening page also lists Karen Alter as Seminar Director.

items.notes: Condensed senior thesis.

items.notes: Condensed senior thesis; acknowledgements are printed on the opening page.

items.notes: Abstract only; the print edition refers readers to the full paper at thenurj.com.

items.title: Rational Design of Irreversible Covalent Inhibitors for E3 Ubiquitin Ligase NEDD4-1
items.notes: Excerpt: abstract and the introductory chapter (Chapter i) with bibliography. The opening page also lists Stefan Kathman as Graduate Mentor.

items.title: Mark Hersam
items.notes: Profile and interview of Mark Hersam, materials scientist and MacArthur Fellow ("interview by Sophie Weber"); the contents page lists it as "Professor Mark Hersam".

items.title: Theo Gao
items.notes: Interview with Theo Gao ('16), an undergraduate researcher in Professor Mark Hersam's lab ("interview by Monica Cheng"). Not listed on the contents page; it follows the Hersam feature.

items.title: Dub, Dub-Key and Dabkeh: Palestinian Resistance Through Reggae Music in Israel
items.notes: Northwestern University in Qatar student paper; its acknowledgements say the original version was written for MIT 398 Alternative Media in the Middle East. The contents page gives the department as "Media & Communications"; the contributors page spells the author's name "Yazan Abu Ghaida" and gives Northwestern University in Qatar, Media & Communication.

items.title: Rethinking the Studio: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Social Networks’ Role in Creative Development
items.notes: Condensed senior thesis. The contents page gives "A MixedMethods Analysis of Social Networks' Role". The contributors page lists 2015 Best Thesis in Sociology.

items.title: Sunday, barī Sunday: An Ethnography of the Gurdwara Sahib of Chicago
items.notes: Condensed senior thesis. The opening page adds the subtitle "The People, the Services, the Music" and footnotes the title word as "baṛī"; it gives the department as "Musicology" and "Asian Studies" on separate lines. The contributors page gives the author's major as Asian Languages & Civilizations.

items.notes: Condensed senior thesis.

items.notes: Abstract only; the print edition refers readers to the full paper at thenurj.com.

items.notes: Condensed senior thesis.

items.title: Hook Up and Rape "Cultures": Recovering Power Relations in the Discourse of Sexual Assault on College Campuses

items.title: Introduction to the Estridentista Works of Manuel Maples Arce: 1921-1927
items.notes: Condensed senior thesis, including the author's English translations of Maples Arce poems printed beside the Spanish originals (sections 102 and 104). The contributors page gives the author's major as Comparative Literary Studies.
